title: Choosing to burn, rest, or bargain a hold's grief is framed as a one-shot, irreversible choice only at the moment of the final action ('settles this hold's grief') — there is no earlier signal that gathering all three resolution items (e.g. verses, pardon, oath) will still only let you pick one.
